label: Forward Pre: Anusvara + Vowel Substitution (ng+vowel → ঙ+matra) + ঙ্গ Handling
logic_description: This function pre-processes English text during Bengali transliteration. It automatically scans the input for the letters "ng" when paired with vowels (like nga or ngai) or when doubled into "ngg", seamlessly converting them into their correct Bengali script structures using "ঙ" (NGA) and "ঙ্গ" (NGA+GA).

logic_description: This function handles the unique phonetic behaviors of the letter "R" during forward transliteration. It reads internal marker characters (\uE000 and \uE001 generated during pre-processing) to determine exactly when "R" should merge with a following consonant to form a cluster, and when it should stay standalone.

label: Shankar: Disable Hardcoded Clustering
logic_description: This function runs as an early pre-processing step to analyze how the letters "r" and "rr" are used in the English input text. It marks them with private internal Unicode codes (\uE000 for rr and \uE001 for r) so that downstream modules (like fwdLoopRHandling) know exactly how to render them.
